text:
Clara (People Ops): FYI Diego uploaded a receipt photo for a taxi in Lyon but the image is blurry and OCR failed. He paid cash and the driver only gave a small handwritten slip. Hes asking if that will be reimbursed.

Diego (Sales): Yep  I paid €18 cash, driver gave me a scribbled slip with date and amount but no company name. I also have a screenshot of the client meeting and a calendar invite.

Marta (Finance): Cash taxi without a merchant imprint is tricky but not automatically denied. We need a reasonable attestation + supporting context.

Clara (People Ops): What exactly do you need Diego to upload so we can process quickly?

Marta (Finance): Upload the blurry photo (we accept imperfect images), the handwritten slip, the calendar invite showing business meeting, and a brief note in the expense comments describing why card wasn't used (e.g., driver only accepted cash). Add manager approval.

Jon (Manager): I confirm I approved Diegos trip and he informed me that the driver only took cash. Approving reimbursement.

Marta (Finance): For audit: add a small attestation line in the expense like: "Cash taxi €18 on 2026-03-10; driver receipt attached; manager Jon approved via Slack." If image unreadable, include a short typed transcription of the slip (date/amount). We'll mark as "accepted with supporting attestation" and code it as "Travel > Ground - Taxi (cash)".

Diego (Sales): Should I try to get a signed or stamped receipt retroactively from the driver? Not realistic here.

Clara (People Ops): Not necessary if manager approval + calendar + attestation are present. But if local law requires VAT invoice for reclaim, wed need it; for most taxi cash items we accept attestation.

Marta (Finance): Also, one-off cash items are fine. If we see repeated pattern of cash claims for the same traveler, Finance will ask for a note and possibly require more evidence.

travel-bot: Policy excerpt: "Cash or handwritten transport receipts are acceptable with manager approval and an attestation in the expense. Attach contextual business proof (meeting invite, itinerary) for audit. Recurrent cash claims may trigger additional verification." :link:

Clara (People Ops): Great  Diego, upload the photos + calendar + Jon's approval text into the expense and add the attestation. We'll process once Marta confirms. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
